description: Jest-style failures with stack noise retain the two failing test files.

files.jest:
for i in $(seq 1 80); do echo "PASS src/unit/module$i.test.ts"; done
echo '● src/auth/session.test.ts'
echo '  Expected: 401'
echo '● src/auth/refresh.test.ts'
echo '  Expected: refreshed token'
echo 'Tests: 80 passed, 2 failed'
exit 1

prompt: Run 'sh jest --fake' and list only the two failing test file paths.
expected_active_behaviour: test reducer retains Jest failure headings without raw PASS noise
